log.thought: I walk over to my little stove by the left wall.
I slice the potatoes and carrots and let them simmer on the warm stove with a little milk and butter.
I sit by the stove and eat my hot potato soup. It tastes so comforting.
I walk over to the piano where my glowing plasma wave sculpture sits waiting.
I tune the sculpture so it hums with deep star frequencies like a vibrating star.
log.name: plasma wave sculpture

log.thought: I press the button and listen to the deep, resonant star hum fill the quiet room.
log.name: plasma wave sculpture
log.label: Listen to plasma waves
log.text: The little glass sphere glows brighter and hums with a deep, pulsing star chord.

log.thought: I will walk over to my piano.
Letting the low notes ring out like the deep hum of a giant star.
log.notes: C3 G3 D4 G4 B4 D5

log.thought: Painting soft purple and cyan light pooling in the darkness.
log.name: Orion Nebula sketch
log.why: to capture the soft, glowing mist of the stellar nursery in the dark night
